newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Belarus president seeks closer links with Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Belarus president seeks closer links with Vietnam.

text.p: Belarus President Alexander Lukashenko was due to arrive in Vietnam late on Wednesday for a visit aimed at bolstering economic and political ties, the official Vietnam News Agency (VNA) said.

Lukashenko is due to hold meetings on Thursday with President Le Duc Anh and Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet and then lay a wreath at the mausoleum of former Vietnamese President Ho Chi Minh before leaving on Friday.

"Each side will discuss a...number of issues to develop not only economic relations but also relations in other fields," VNA quoted Lukashenko as saying in a message sent to Anh. "We also hope that the visit will take our bilateral relations to new heights."
